SkuItem.title: SkuItem
SkuItem.description: Represents a vendor product SKU with package dimensions, dead weight, volumetric weight optimization, and shipping charge savings.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

productName.description: Name of the Meesho product SKU.

category.description: Product category (e.g. Ethnic Wear, Kitchen, Footwear, Electronics).

currentShippingCharge.description: Current Meesho shipping fee in INR before optimization.

optimizedShippingCharge.description: Optimized Meesho shipping fee in INR after packaging/dimension reduction.

monthlyOrders.description: Estimated monthly order volume for this SKU.

recommendation.description: Actionable packaging and dimension reduction recommendation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the SKU was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the SKU was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MemberProfile.title: MemberProfile
MemberProfile.description: Represents an Admin or any Person/Vendor/Staff profile whose name and role can be edited or deleted.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated workspace owner.

personName.description: Full name of the admin or person (editable).

isAdminPerson.description: Whether this person entry holds Admin designation in the vendor workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was provisioned.

/skus/{skuId}.description: Stores vendor product SKUs and shipping charge optimization analyses.

/members/{memberId}.description: Stores Admin and Person directory records allowing name edits, role updates, and deletions.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only admin registry for RBAC verification.
